status.sourceNotRunning: Waiting for {source} — the player you pinned is not running (tray → Playback source → Auto-detect to follow any app)
settings.lyricsServer.hint: If set, Musebase asks this server before searching lyrics providers, and uploads newly found lyrics (with translations) so your other devices do not search or translate again. Leave empty to disable. Example: https://oracle.example.ts.net
settings.preferredSources.hint: Pick one or more apps to use ONLY those as the lyrics source — podcasts and video apps will be ignored. Leave all unchecked for automatic detection (browsers, video and podcast apps are excluded automatically). Apps that are not running cannot be listed until they play once.
settings.title: Musebase Settings
settings.translation.fallback: Switch to free translation (MyMemory) automatically when the selected engine fails
settings.translation.fallback.warn: When on, lyrics may be sent to the public free-translation server (MyMemory) if the primary engine fails.
settings.translation.key.hint.google: Enable the Cloud Translation API in the Google Cloud console, create an API key, and paste it here (paid, usage-based).
settings.deepl.lang.header: Translation target language (DeepL target_lang, default: system language)
settings.translation.libre.endpoint: LibreTranslate endpoint (blank = default; self-host for reliability)
settings.translation.openrouter.hint: One key, many models. e.g. anthropic/claude-opus-5, openai/gpt-5-mini. Unlike machine translators an LLM can return the wrong number of lines; those batches are shown untranslated rather than misaligned.
settings.sources.hint: Unofficial sources may pose ToS/copyright risks when the project is published. Enable at your discretion.
settings.sources.restart: Lyrics-source changes take effect after restart.
settings.browserDisplay.hint: Show live lyrics in a web browser on a tablet or TV. Turn it on from the tray menu ("Browser display").
settings.browserDisplay.lan: Allow other devices on your LAN to connect
settings.browserDisplay.lan.hint: You may need to allow Musebase through Windows Firewall. Port/LAN changes apply the next time browser display starts.
settings.fontHint:
Text size adjusts automatically to the overlay size.
(Hover the overlay and click the lock → move/resize mode)
settings.hideSameTranslation: Hide translation identical to the original
settings.onlyTargetTranslation: Show only the target-language translation (needs a DeepL key; provider translations, usually Chinese, are hidden)
settings.hideOnMouseOver: Hide overlay on mouse-over (avoid blocking the screen)
settings.telemetry.resetId.done: A new anonymous ID will be used from now on. Previously sent data cannot be linked to it.
settings.backup.hint: For moving to another PC or a fresh install. API keys and tokens are locked to this PC, so copying the settings file loses them — export re-locks them with a password, and import re-locks them with the new PC's own lock.
settings.backup.exported: Exported. Anyone with the password can open this file on any PC — keep it somewhere safe.
settings.backup.exported.noSecrets: Exported. No password was given, so API keys and tokens were left out.
settings.backup.imported: Imported. Window positions and the device id keep this PC's own values. Closing settings to apply.
settings.backup.password.hint: API keys and tokens are locked with this password. Leave it blank to export without them (other settings still move).
settings.backup.password.hint.import: Enter the password chosen when this backup was made.
settings.backup.password.label: Password
settings.backup.password.mismatch: The two entries do not match.
telemetry.consent.title: Musebase — Usage statistics
telemetry.consent.intro: Would you like to help improve Musebase by sharing anonymous usage statistics? Nothing is collected unless you opt in. The identifier is a random ID created on this device, and no lyrics text, listening history, or personal data is ever sent.
telemetry.consent.basic: Basic statistics — features, performance, environment. No song information.
telemetry.consent.quality: Quality reports — includes the song title and artist of tracks whose lyrics were not found or that you marked as wrong lyrics.
telemetry.consent.note: Both options are off by default. You can change them anytime in Settings → General.
tray.apiTranslation.tooltip: Off = no new translation requests are sent (paid API usage stops); already cached translations still show. Turning it back on translates the current song right away.
